title: Markdown in every part — dedup tickets on save

change.title: Dedup tickets on save
change.description:
Fixes **duplicate tickets** when two saves race. Follows up on [#38](https://example.com/acme/pulls/38).

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| last write wins, twice | one row per `id` |
| ~120 ms per batch | ~40 ms per batch |

> Rolled out behind the `dedup_v2` flag first.

overview.summary:
Dedups tickets **before** the bulk insert, and backfills the new `bucket` column.

The change has two parts:

1. `do_save/2` drops repeated ids with `Enum.uniq_by/2`, keeping the *first* write.
2. A migration adds `bucket` and fills it in batches of `1_000`.

```elixir
tickets
|> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
|> Repo.insert_all(on_conflict: :nothing)
```

See [the incident](https://example.com/incidents/412) for why.
overview.concerns:
### What I looked at

- **Ordering:** whether `uniq_by` keeps the *first* or the *last* write.
- **Backfill:** does it run on read or on write?
  - on read would slow the first request
  - on write needs a lock
- Anything touching `Repo.insert_all/3`.

> I did not review the test fixtures.

files.summary: `do_save/2` drops repeated ids with `Enum.uniq_by/2` before the bulk insert, keeping the **first** write.
files.diff:
@@ -145,9 +145,11 @@ defmodule Acme.Tickets do
   def do_save(items) do
     items
-    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
-    |> Enum.reverse()
+    |> Enum.reverse()
+    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
+    |> Enum.reverse()
     |> Repo.insert_all()
   end
 
   defp normalise(item), do: item

files.summary:
Adds the `bucket` column and backfills it in *batches of 1,000*.

The backfill runs on write, behind the `dedup_v2` flag.
files.diff:
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 defmodule Acme.Repo.Migrations.AddBucket do
   use Ecto.Migration
 
   def change do
-    alter table(:tickets), do: add(:bucket, :string)
+    alter table(:tickets), do: add(:bucket, :string, default: "main")
+    execute("UPDATE tickets SET bucket = COALESCE(bucket, 'main')", "")
   end
 end

proposals.title: reversing twice is a no-op with a cost
proposals.body:
The second `Enum.reverse/1` undoes the first, so `uniq_by` still keeps the last write.

```suggestion
    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
```

proposals.title: COALESCE hides a real NULL
proposals.body:
Agreed with the backfill, but the default should stay off until it ran.

**Why it matters:** a `NULL` in `bucket` is *not* the same as `0`.

1. Query with `IS NULL`
2. Then decide

comments.author: reviewer-bot
comments.body: A default on the column masks rows the backfill missed.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Fair, I added the backfill. Good enough?

proposals.title: typo in the module doc
proposals.body:
A typo in the module doc:

- `recieve` → `receive`
- `occured` → `occurred`

> Spelling also matters in `@moduledoc`, which `mix docs` publishes.

See the [style guide](https://example.com/style#spelling).
